topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Heard tell of a painter from the town, his work taken and inked into the skin of a man. Such a thing, it makes the mind wander, thinking of the colors and the shapes that now journey beyond canvas, living a life of their own. The farmer’s duty is to the earth, yet even in tilling the fields, there's a creation, a sense of bringing forth. This painter, whoever he be, his art now walks the earth as a part of another. A curious turn, indeed. I can almost picture the hands that hold the brush, now marked by the pride of another’s vision. May the saints guide both the artist and the bearer of such bold work.
